sloka: जातमात्रेण हि पुरा तेन रावणसूनुना ।रुदता सुमहान्मुक्तो नादो जलधरोपमः ।। ७.१२.२९ ॥
transliteration: jātamātreṇa hi purā tena rāvaṇasūnunā ।rudatā sumahānmukto nādo jaladharopamaḥ ।। 7.12.29 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, immediately after his birth, Ravana's son, while crying, emitted a tremendous roar resembling a thundercloud.
